d:
Coach Liz has signed up for some incredible challenges this year, and her next stop is the beautiful Green Mountains of Vermont for the epic Bloodroot 10 Miler! This race features dirt trails, rocky paths, gnarly roots, and mountainous terrain, home to the legendary Spartan Death Race. Can Coach Liz conquer the 10-miler after her comeback from a back injury? Watch to find out!
